description: The unsigned Lah number L(n, k). L(0, 0) is 1, L(n, 0) is 0 for n > 0, and L(n, 1) is n!. L(5, 2) is 240, and L(6, 3) is 1200. n and k run from 0 to 20, and k must not pass n. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/lah
